description: A shell script for testing gitweb as a standalone CGI script, performing various tests on git repository states, commits, diffs, tags, logs, and configurations.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Function to execute the gitweb script with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Function to run a test expecting success with a description and command.

methods.name: test_lazy_prereq
methods.description: Function to check for optional prerequisites before running tests.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Function to register cleanup commands after tests.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Function to set or check git configuration for tests.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Function to run commands that might fail without failing the test.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Function to create symbolic links and add them to git.

methods.name: test_chmod
methods.description: Function to change file permissions during tests.
